title: Streaming AI UX
description: Implement streaming AI responses with real-time UI updates and user controls.

data.text: Streaming responses require real-time UI updates. Implement Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket clients, handle backpressure, and provide user controls.

data.title: Streaming Response Component
Key Takeaways
points: Use fetch with ReadableStream for streaming
data.takeaway: Streaming UX requires careful handling of chunks, cancellation, and errors. Provide user controls and handle connection issues gracefully.
